probePolicy.actual: Official publisher diagnostic target, where available. A diagnostic target is not necessarily a match-host IP.
probePolicy.alternative: AWS GameLift UDP beacons are regional infrastructure tests ONLY, not game servers.
probePolicy.locationOnly: Official or disclosed gaming region with no validated public test IP. host is intentionally empty and must not be pinged.
probePolicy.unverified: Historical/community service addresses must not be advertised as current game servers. User should live-verify.
probePolicy.warning: There are NO universal static IP lists for every game. Game-specific match latency may differ from ICMP/UDP beacon RTT.
probePolicy.liveNetworkTest: Not performed in this environment. Only documentary source checks and JSON/schema validation were performed.
